message.content:
Sure! To run an integrated regression (ireg) you’ll need to specify which product’s regression you want to execute. The `run_ireg` function accepts one of the following product codes:

| Product Code | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| `fc` | Full Chip regression |
| `starrc` | Star RC extraction regression |
| `pt` | PrimeTime timing analysis regression |
| `nt` | NanoTime timing analysis regression |

**What do you want to run?**  
- If you’re debugging a particular product, let me know the code (`fc`, `starrc`, `pt`, or `nt`).  
- If you’re not sure which one applies, give me a bit more context about the bug (e.g., “timing issue”, “layout mismatch”, etc.) and I can help you pick the right product.

Once you tell me the product code, I can show you the exact command or function call to execute the ireg.
